items.title: Use of Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Antivirus Tools

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Use of Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Antivirus Tools under 9.2 as printed (PDF 127, printed 123).

blocks.text: A firewall acts as a barrier between a computer and the internet, allowing safe data to pass while blocking harmful traffic. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) monitor networks for suspicious activities and alert users about possible threats. Antivirus software scans files and removes viruses or malware before they cause damage. Together, these tools form a powerful defense against cyberattacks. Using them regularly ensures that computers and networks remain protected and run smoothly.
